data.narrative:
Limelight Steel is a pre-seed stage company in the Climate & Energy sector that has raised $6M to date. The comparable universe consists of 1 public company and 8 private peers operating in the same sector, including names such as Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

The Stage-Progression method is applicable here and serves as the primary valuation tool. Using the $6M total raised as a proxy for current enterprise value and applying a 2.5x multiplier—the typical step-up from Pre-Seed to the next funding stage—yields an implied valuation of $15M. The Peer-Median approach was not applicable due to insufficient datapoints: while 8 same-sector peers exist, none matched the narrow filters of same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier, falling short of the three-company threshold needed for robust triangulation.

This analysis supports a valuation range of $13M to $17M, centered on $15M. The narrow methodological basis—relying on a single step-up multiplier with no peer validation—represents the primary uncertainty. Additional diligence on technology differentiation, market timing, and founder track record would be required to refine this range. Any future round of financing should incorporate market comps at comparable maturity levels to strengthen conviction.
